claims.text: Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation incorporates structured knowledge from knowledge graphs to enable LLMs to perform reasoning.
Ca2KG integrates counterfactual prompting to expose retrieval-dependent uncertainties in knowledge quality and reasoning reliability.
Ca2KG uses a panel-based re-scoring mechanism to stabilise predictions across interventions.

evidence.description: Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) extends the RAG paradigm by incorporating structured knowledge from knowledge graphs, enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform more precise and explainable reasoning.
Ca2KG integrates counterfactual prompting, which exposes retrieval-dependent uncertainties in knowledge quality and reasoning reliability...
...with a panel-based re-scoring mechanism that stabilises predictions across interventions.

methodologies.name: Ca2KG
methodologies.description: A causality-aware calibration framework for KG-RAG that combines counterfactual prompting with a panel-based re-scoring mechanism.

limitations.text: Existing KG-RAG models are often severely overconfident, producing high-confidence predictions even when retrieved sub-graphs are incomplete or unreliable.
